title: unakkul naane
why: a dreamy, romantic track built around the feeling of having someone constantly on your mind. the soft, poetic imagery makes it feel incredibly intimate (and also i love r&b).

title: silhouette
why: i feel like this song could be applied to a million different contexts, and it feels so relevant now with what's going on in the world. it's beautiful, and also sobering.

title: kimi no heart wa marine blue
queries: Kimi no Heart wa Marine Blue Omega Tribe
君のハートはマリンブルー 杉山清貴
why: there's this bakudeku fanfiction on AO3 that genuinely changed my brain chemistry and it was set in a 90s aesthetic type town in rural Japan. this song feels like driving through that town, living that life. this song is escape.

title: детство
why: "детство" means "childhood," but this is less about carefree nostalgia and more about looking back at a young relationship that fell apart. it's super bittersweet and melancholic and i absolutely love it.

title: palmeras
why: can you tell how much i love summer nights yet

title: wahdon
why: this song is a classic and i think most people my age have heard it at some point. it has this wistful, almost hypnotic quality. the lyrics dwell on people who have left and the loneliness they leave behind.

title: freund & feind
why: the title means "friend and foe," and it's about this dichotomy between loyalty and conflict, in a political sense. look up the translation. it's worth it. breathtaking, heartbreaking poetry.

title: huang cheng du
why: this song i believe was actually made for the Chinese Netflix drama "The Untamed," which is based off the danmei titled "Mo Dao Zu Shi" or Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation. this song is probably the foremost example in my mind of the pinnacle of male soprano performance. hats off to Zhou Shen fr.

title: kaise hua
why: this track captures love's chameleonic power to rebuild you from within and ignite a profound sense of purpose. it has recently dethroned Bekhayali (a Hindi rock song) in my "on repeat" for this month.

title: corps
why: "corps" means "body." i have been reflecting a lot as of late on what it means to be a woman in the society we live in, and what work i have to do to circumvent the standards that have been imposed upon us for centuries. a lot of that starts from the inside. this song is about refusing to submit to conventional beauty standards, refusing to sacrifice self-love. it's something i have to remind myself of from time to time. amazing song if you're interested in a piano ballad.
